title: Fix three scattered boundary defects across mixed-line-ending files and update JSON config without disturbing byte formats

prompt.zh: 这是 signal-engine 配置引擎。docs/BOUNDARY.md 记录了三处已确认的边界缺陷（分布在 src/limits.mjs 与 src/budget.mjs 的不同函数中）以及 policy.json 需要的两处配置更新。请严格按文档逐一修复三处缺陷并更新 policy.json；不要改动 README.md、package.json、config.schema.json、docs/ 与 test/ 下任何文件。完成后运行 `npm test` 确认全部测试通过。特别注意：limits.mjs 与 budget.mjs 保留 BOM、CRLF 换行与部分行尾空白（与 ops 管道对齐的格式要求），修改时必须原样保留这些未触碰区域的字节格式，不要重排或清理；policy.json 修改后必须仍是合法 JSON。
prompt.en: This is signal-engine, a small configuration engine. docs/BOUNDARY.md documents three confirmed boundary defects (scattered across different functions in src/limits.mjs and src/budget.mjs) plus two required policy.json updates. Fix the three defects exactly as documented and update policy.json; do not modify README.md, package.json, config.schema.json, docs/ or anything under test/. Run `npm test` afterwards to confirm every test passes. Note: limits.mjs and budget.mjs intentionally keep a BOM, CRLF line endings and some trailing whitespace (aligned with the ops pipeline); your edits must preserve these byte formats in untouched regions — no reformatting or cleanup. policy.json must stay valid JSON after your edit.
